# AIO Fusion

> AIO Fusion is a GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) platform that helps PR agencies and B2B communications teams measure and improve how their brands appear in AI answers from ChatGPT and Claude.

The platform audits AI visibility, tracks brand authority, and supports the planning, creation and optimisation of PR and marketing content designed to be discovered, cited and recommended by AI answer engines.

## Public resources

- [Promo video](https://aiofusion.ai/aio-fusion-promo/): see how AIO Fusion helps brands win AI visibility.
- [AIO Fusion homepage](https://aiofusion.ai/): overview of the platform and its tools.
